simple.meaning: כֵּילַף (kêylaph) is a Hebrew word meaning “a club or sledge-hammer.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כֵּילַף (H3597) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כֵּילַף (H3597) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כֵּילַף (kêylaph) / H3597 is traced through Psalms 74:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3597. kelappoth כֵּילַמּוֺת noun [feminine] axe (loan-word (compare Frä 74 ) from Assyrian kalappatu see Dl HWB 333 ) — וְכ ׳בְּכַשִּׁיל יַהֲלֹמ֑וּן Psa 74:6 (|| קַרְדֻּמּוֺת 74:5 ). כִּימָה see below כום .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise;

occurrences.englishText: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
